clue.text: Award about one pound in return for type of service

indicators.note: in return asks for the whole assembled piece to be read backwards
about means the award goes around the other pieces

parts.note: a cup is a prize awarded to a winner
one is the Roman numeral I
LB is the abbreviation for a pound in weight

explanation.surface: Someone is given a prize worth a pound in exchange for some kind of service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the award round one pound, and 'in return' turns the whole result back to front, CILBUP reading as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Public service is a kind of service, so the word qualifies service as a type of it.

clue.text: Fierce feeder in country hospital in Pennsylvania

indicators.note: in places the country and hospital inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for Pennsylvania
Iran is a country
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A ferocious eater is found in a country hospital in Pennsylvania.
explanation.definitionFit: This South American fish is famous for its savage, frenzied feeding on flesh.

clue.text: White African women admitted to the arbour

indicators.note: admitted to means the women letter is let inside the other word

parts.note: a Boer is a white South African of Dutch descent

explanation.surface: A white South African lets women into the garden shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A bower is a shady leafy shelter in a garden, the same thing as an arbour.

clue.text: Tasteless popular drink has character

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
to sip is to drink
the id is part of the psyche, one's basic character in Freudian terms

explanation.surface: A fashionable drink that has a distinctive character turns out to be bland.
explanation.definitionFit: Insipid food or drink lacks flavour, which is to say it is tasteless.

clue.text: Weeds stifling American dynasties

indicators.note: stifling means smothering, so one word wraps around the other

parts.note: to weed a bed is to hoe it, so weeds as a verb gives hoes

explanation.surface: Weeds choke an American plant, or perhaps powerful American families.
explanation.definitionFit: A royal or noble house is a family line, synonymous with a dynasty, as in the House of Windsor.

clue.text: Decree kingdom with no capital is to adopt Italy's

indicators.note: to adopt means taking the Italian letter into the trimmed kingdom
with no capital means losing the initial (capital) letter

parts.note: Jordan is a Middle Eastern kingdom
I is the international vehicle registration code for Italy

explanation.surface: A ruler decrees that a kingdom without a capital city is to take on Italy's ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no capital' strips the J from JORDAN, leaving ORDAN; 'to adopt' puts I inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to order officially or decree, as a law or ruler does.

clue.text: Eunuch drinking gin — it's a painful experience

indicators.note: drinking means taking in, so the eunuch word swallows the gin word

parts.note: spado is an old legal term for a castrated or impotent man
a gin is a snare or trap for game

explanation.surface: A eunuch drinking gin finds it a painful experience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gin' is not the spirit but a snare.
explanation.definitionFit: The strappado was a torture in which the victim was hoisted by the wrists and dropped, certainly painful.

clue.text: Thus brought up, animal receives penny reward for doing nothing

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the piece is read from the bottom upwards
receives means the animal takes the penny inside it

parts.note: a yak is an animal

explanation.surface: A creature raised this way gets a penny as a reward for idleness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receives' puts P inside YAK to make YAPK; 'brought up' turns that to KPAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Sick pay is money received while off work ill, wryly a reward for not working.

clue.text: Take pot with hotter drug whilst tipsy, as men do in 1across 4?

indicators.note: tipsy describes drunken unsteadiness, so the letters lurch into a new order

explanation.surface: Advice to smoke pot along with some stronger drug while drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of POT and HOTTER DRUG WHILST are rearranged; 1 and 4 across give PUBLIC HOUSES, where drinkers famously settle all the world's problems.
explanation.definitionFit: Pub drinkers are proverbially given to discussing and solving all global problems over a pint.

clue.text: The attraction of the Lottery

definitions.meaning: the lottery ... is when winning numbers are picked

explanation.definitionFit: A draw means both a crowd-puller and the picking of winning numbers in a lottery.

clue.text: Healthy way to compose music

parts.note: sound means healthy, as in sound in mind and body
a track is a path or way

explanation.surface: Advice that a healthy approach is the way to write music.
explanation.definitionFit: A film's recorded score and songs are its music, the accompanying audio.

clue.text: Companion not entirely bowled over by catch

indicators.note: bowled over means knocked head over heels, so the word is turned back to front
not entirely means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a partner is a companion

explanation.surface: A companion is not wholly knocked flat by a cricket catch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' cuts PARTNER to PARTNE, and 'bowled over' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrap is to catch someone, as in a snare or trick.

clue.text: A tipple — one concocted in back of an automobile?

indicators.note: concocted means mixed up, so the letters are combined in a new order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A drink, mixed up in the back of a car.
explanation.definitionFit: The exhaust outlet sits at the rear of a car, so this tube is part of its back end.

clue.text: Medicare provision initially shambolic? Go for it!

indicators.note: shambolic means chaotic, so these letters are jumbled
initially picks out the first letter of provision

explanation.surface: Healthcare provision in the US is a shambles from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: MEDICARE plus P (the first letter of provision), shuffled ('shambolic').
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin motto means seize the day, an exhortation to act boldly now.

clue.text: Every artist embraces New Wave of sorts

parts.note: per means for each or every, as in once per day

indicators.note: embraces means the artist holds the new letter inside

parts.note: Manet was a French painter

explanation.surface: Every painter takes up the New Wave in some form.
explanation.walkthrough: A perm is a hair wave, so 'Wave of sorts' is a hairdo, not the film movement 'New Wave' suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: A perm, short for permanent wave, is a chemically set hair curl.

clue.text: Easily impressed by kiss en route?

indicators.note: en is French for in, so the kiss goes inside the route

parts.note: a way is a route
X is the symbol for a kiss

explanation.surface: Someone easily charmed by a kiss on the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Wax takes any impression readily, so something waxy is soft and easily marked.

clue.text: Annoy singer

definitions.meaning: a singer is an informer who sings to the police; slang for such a person

explanation.definitionFit: Nark is British slang both for irritating someone and for a police informer.

clue.text: The language of Lithuania (minus 2) in translation

indicators.note: in translation means rendered differently, so the letters are rearranged
minus means the two letters are taken away

parts.note: 2 is II in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Lithuanian with a couple of things missing, translated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'minus 2' removes the two I's from LITHUANIA, leaving LTHUANA, and 'in translation' rearranges that.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Aztec tongue still spoken in central Mexico, a real language.

clue.text: Scumbag eating zero degree stew

indicators.note: eating means the scumbag wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: a louse is a contemptible person
O resembles zero
BSc is a Bachelor of Science degree

explanation.surface: A lowlife eating stew at no level of qualification.
explanation.walkthrough: Lobscouse is a sailors' meat and vegetable stew, the source of the Liverpool word scouse.
explanation.definitionFit: Lobscouse is a traditional sailors' hash of meat, vegetables and ship's biscuit.

clue.text: Playwright maintains the study of Scripture is what a junkie needs

indicators.note: maintains means holds, so the playwright contains the study

parts.note: J M Synge was an Irish playwright
RI is religious instruction, a school subject in Britain

explanation.surface: A dramatist argues that Bible study is what a drug addict needs.
explanation.definitionFit: A drug addict injects with a hypodermic, the needle-and-plunger device.

clue.text: Ceremonies involving a female raised the barometer reading

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means read from bottom to top
involving means the ceremonies take the other letters inside

parts.note: rites are ceremonies

explanation.surface: Ceremonies involving a woman made the barometer rise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' puts AF inside RITES to give RIAFTES, and 'raised' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest marking on an old barometer dial forecasts steady good weather.

clue.text: Take cover and harden without beginning to soften

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so harden goes around the letter

parts.note: to inure is to harden or accustom

indicators.note: beginning to picks the first letter of soften

explanation.surface: Advice to take shelter and toughen up without beginning to go soft.
explanation.definitionFit: To insure is to take out an insurance policy, i.e. to get cover.

clue.text: Pole on charge in the unfinished "Case of the Flying Fragments"

indicators.note: in places the charge and pole inside the shortened case
unfinished means the last letter is lopped off

parts.note: a shell is a case or casing

indicators.note: on means the pole letter follows the charge in an across clue

parts.note: a rap is a criminal charge
N is the north pole

explanation.surface: A detective story title: The Case of the Flying Fragments.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a mystery-novel title; 'Case' is the casing of an artillery round, cut short by 'unfinished' to SHEL.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrapnel is the metal fragments flung out by an exploding shell.

clue.text: See 8
Cut off bits, keeping one frozen

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the cutting verb goes around one

parts.note: to geld is to castrate, cutting off certain bits
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A cruel instruction to cut off pieces of something frozen.
explanation.definitionFit: Gelid means icy cold, a literary word for frozen.

clue.text: "Writer of the Month" finds Vichy water's 10

parts.note: Jan is short for January
eau is French for water, Vichy being a French spa town, plus the S of the possessive
10 is the number ten, not the cross-reference it seems

explanation.surface: A literary magazine's featured author of the month discovers French mineral water.
explanation.walkthrough: '10' looks like a cross-reference to 10 across but is just the number.
explanation.definitionFit: The author of Pride and Prejudice is one of the best-known English novelists.

clue.text: Idle pate

definitions.meaning: pate means the head; ... is British slang for head, as in use your ...

explanation.definitionFit: Loaf means to laze around, and in British slang it also means the head.

clue.text: Mechanism for turning right in an agitated state

parts.note: a lathe is a machine for turning wood or metal

explanation.surface: Turning a lathe the right way in a state of agitation.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a lather is to be flustered or worked up, an idiom from sweating horses.

clue.text: Goal let in by whistle-blower moving from right to left wing in America

indicators.note: let in by means the goal is admitted inside the official
moving from right to left means the official's word is read backwards

parts.note: the ref, short for referee, blows the whistle
an end is a goal or aim

explanation.surface: A goal conceded by a referee switching flanks in American football.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wing' is the car body panel, not a winger; in the US it is the fender.
explanation.definitionFit: American English calls a car's wing, the panel over the wheel, a fender.
